name: Rishirifuji (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Rishirifuji town emblem in white: a broken ring topped by a bar, enclosing a stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Rishirifuji, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 September 1959.

features.role: Rishirifuji town emblem — a broken ring topped by a bar, enclosing a stylised mountain
